subject: Compliance punchlist for expansion: SOC 2 Type II and bridge
body:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Lisa Brown <lisa.brown@orbitalhealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance punchlist for expansion: SOC 2 Type II and bridge

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — our procurement and security teams are lining up the materials we need to sign off on the expansion PO. To avoid a procurement hold, can you confirm the following items by 2028-04-15 (our PO approval cutoff):

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine)
- Letter to cover the audit window gap (bridge/interim attestation) if your most recent Type II report period does not cover into Q2 2028
- A short procurement punchlist that confirms in-scope services and whether any customer-managed keys or on-prem components are required

We are expanding from a pilot to a company-wide license contingent on receiving the above. If you can provide a draft bridge letter and a redacted report, we can route to legal and speed up the PO.

Thanks,
Lisa Brown
Sr. Procurement Manager
Orbital Health
procurement@orbitalhealth.com

--- Message 2 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Brown <lisa.brown@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, ava.chen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance punchlist for expansion: SOC 2 Type II and bridge

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear checklist.

Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a redacted Type II report and a signed bridge letter; we will also share a one-sheet procurement punchlist. Im looping in Neha (security/compliance) to prepare the artifacts and Ava (your AE) to help with PO routing and timing.

Neha/Ava — can you prepare: (1) redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF suitable for procurement/legal, (2) a dated bridge letter that covers the audit gap and specifies the audit period covered, and (3) a single-sheet procurement_punchlist for Orbital that lists in-scope services and any special controls (e.g., customer-managed keys). Lisa, is redaction ok for the report or do you need an unredacted version under an NDA?

Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

--- Message 3 ---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Brown <lisa.brown@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Mar 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance punchlist for expansion: SOC 2 Type II and bridge

Hi Lisa, Karthik, Ava — attaching the requested artifacts.

Attachments included (stubs below):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-redacted.pdf (redacted copy: control descriptions removed where they reference vendor-specific details; audit firm signatures retained)
- Bridge_Letter_20280304.pdf (signed by our Head of Security; covers audit window extension through 2028-03-31)
- procurement_punchlist_Orbital.xlsx (single-sheet with in-scope services, KMS notes, and contact points)

A few clarifications for procurement:
- Audit period on the attached Type II is 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30. The bridge letter affirms continuous control operation and is dated 2028-03-04; it is intended to provide interim assurance through 2028-03-31 while our next attestation is scheduled (audit kickoff Q2 2028).
- Scope: Redwood serving runtime, API, and Redwood Console (observability/ops). Private on-prem packages are out of scope unless specifically contracted.
- SIG/CAIQ: we have an up-to-date SIG questionnaire and a CAIQ baseline; I can provide a signed SIG pack for legal under an NDA or point you to the secure folder (link below).

Secure artifacts (read-only):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDq-example-link

If you need the unredacted Type II for legal review, tell us and well prepare a controlled-access package via our vendor vault (requires an exchange of an NDA or an access request).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-redacted.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB, redactions applied)
- Bridge_Letter_20280304.pdf (PDF, 45KB, signed)
- procurement_punchlist_Orbital.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

--- Message 4 ---
From: Lisa Brown <lisa.brown@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Thu, 09 Mar 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance punchlist for expansion: SOC 2 Type II and bridge

Karthik / Neha — this is great, thank you. The redacted report and bridge letter look fine for our legal review. Well route to legal today; if they confirm, we will release the PO hold and issue the PO change for expansion.

Request: can you send the bridge letter via DocuSign (we need an executed copy dated) and include your company DUNS number on the document? Also, on the procurement punchlist: please confirm whether customer-managed KMS is available for Dedicated instances (a yes/no and short note).

If we get the executed bridge letter and the KMS confirmation by 2028-03-16, we can meet our internal PO cycle and have a PO to you by 2028-04-01.

Thanks,
Lisa
Sr. Procurement Manager
Orbital Health
procurement@orbitalhealth.com

> On Sun, Mar 4, 2028 at 3:20 PM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> Hi Lisa, Karthik, Ava  attaching the requested artifacts.
> 
> [Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027-redacted.pdf, Bridge_Letter_20280304.pdf, procurement_punchlist_Orbital.xlsx]
